description: This file contains the implementation of the Footer controller class within the OpenCart admin panel. The class extends a core Controller class and defines an index method that loads language data, checks user login status for version display, and returns the footer view with relevant data.

classes.name: Footer
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering the footer section in the admin interface of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the footer view, conditionally displaying the software version if the user is logged in and has a valid user token.
